6241de1981.q: Why did Canva lay off 22% of its workforce and what severance package did it offer?
6241de1981.a: Canva laid off 22% of their workforce, but they paid out all employees six months' pay regardless of service, vested all their stocks, let employees keep their devices, and offered $10,000 to $15,000 USD grants to anyone starting their own business. They massively overhired around the COVID crisis and are bringing headcount back to pre-COVID levels, but also faced a real drop-off in user numbers for the first time.

704d2e2ae1.q: What happened with Heidi Health after raising $130 million and achieving unicorn status in September?
704d2e2ae1.a: Heidi Health achieved unicorn status in September 2024 and raised another $130 million on a billion-dollar valuation, doubling their previous round. However, six weeks later they laid off 18% of employees and two of their three co-founders left the company. They had rapidly grown from 80 to 600 employees in under two years and hired expensive enterprise sales people to sell into hospitals and large medical companies.
